preconditions.description: The number of pillars n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The minimum height difference d is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The list of pillar heights h has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hi <= 10**15 for hi in h)
preconditions.description: Each pillar height hi is between 1 and 1,000,000,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The length of the maximal jump sequence k is between 1 and n inclusive.
The list of indices has exactly k elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in indices)
postconditions.description: Each index i in the list of indices is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(i1 < i2 for i1, i2 in zip(indices, indices[1:]))
postconditions.description: The indices in the list are strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(h[i1-1] - h[i2-1]) >= d for i1, i2 in zip(indices, indices[1:]))
postconditions.description: The height difference between consecutive pillars in the sequence is at least d.
